paper.title_en: Phase transition for a black hole with matter fields and the relation with the Lyapunov exponent
paper.abstract_en: We construct static black hole solutions coexisting with anisotropic matter in asymptotically (anti-)de Sitter spacetime and investigate how the matter field modifies their thermodynamic and dynamical properties. The anisotropic matter generates an exponentially decaying charge-like contribution to the metric, causing the geometry to interpolate between the Schwarzschild black hole in anti-de Sitter spacetime and the Reissner-Nordström black hole in anti-de Sitter spacetime. In anti-de Sitter black hole spacetime, we derive the complete thermodynamic description, including the Hawking temperature, heat capacity, Smarr relation, generalized first law, and Helmholtz free energy. The system exhibits a van der Waals-type small/large black hole phase transition with a critical point determined by the matter field parameters. Local thermodynamic stability is characterized by the heat capacity, whereas global stability is determined through the free energy. We further investigate unstable homoclinic orbits by evaluating the Lyapunov exponent associated with null geodesics. Our analysis reveals that different thermodynamic branches possess distinct dynamical instabilities, and that the thermodynamically preferred phase is accompanied by a smaller Lyapunov exponent. These results demonstrate that thermodynamic stability and geodesic instability are correlated because both originate from the same underlying spacetime geometry.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文构建了具有各向异性物质的黑洞解，完整推导了热力学量，揭示了范德瓦尔斯型相变，并将热力学稳定性与李雅普诺夫指数关联，理论深度高且具有创新性。
decision.title_zh: 具有物质场的黑洞相变及其与李雅普诺夫指数的关系
decision.abstract_zh: 我们构造了渐近（反）德西特时空中与各向异性物质并存的静态黑洞解，并研究了物质场如何改变其热力学和动力学性质。各向异性物质在度规中产生指数衰减的类电荷贡献，使得几何在反德西特时空中的史瓦西黑洞与反德西特时空中的赖斯纳-诺德斯特伦黑洞之间插值。在反德西特黑洞时空中，我们推导了完整的热力学描述，包括霍金温度、热容、斯马尔关系、广义第一定律和亥姆霍兹自由能。系统表现出范德瓦尔斯型的小/大黑洞相变，其临界点由物质场参数决定。局部热力学稳定性通过热容表征，而全局稳定性通过自由能确定。我们进一步通过评估与零测地线相关的李雅普诺夫指数来研究不稳定的同宿轨道。我们的分析揭示了不同的热力学分支具有不同的动力学不稳定性，并且热力学优先相伴随着较小的李雅普诺夫指数。这些结果表明热力学稳定性和测地线不稳定性是相关的，因为它们都源于相同的底层时空几何。
